description: Lists the projects this token has access to as {items, page, pageSize, total, hasMore} - the paging every listing of this server answers with (riddle://reference/concepts/response-envelope), here 25 per page, 100 max, so an account with many projects can be paged through; a project API token only ever returns its own project. Each entry is a trimmed summary (id, name, image): project_get adds your permissions on one, project_get_settings its default Riddle settings. An invalid page/pageSize (zero, negative, or over 100) is rejected rather than silently clamped.

page.description: Page number to fetch (1-indexed). Defaults to 1. Zero, negative or non-numeric is rejected, not clamped.

pageSize.description: How many projects to return per page (max 100). Defaults to 25. Same validation as page; over 100 is rejected, not clamped.

name: project_list
